title: Inspect audit pagination and empty-state distinctions
source_kind: git archive of exact commit; no Git metadata or runtime data

findings.evidence: CLI --json/--list always calls listAuditReceipts with limit 5000 and no offset. TUI loadItems uses PAGE_SIZE+1 and truncated (packages/tui/src/app.ts:31,154-169). App activity limit 1-50 with no truncated flag (packages/cli/src/app/host.ts:43-45,189-191).
findings.invariant: A page that is not the last page must not look complete.
findings.current: Older canon receipts beyond 5000 (CLI) or 50 (app) disappear with status ok and no next/truncated field.
findings.smallest_correction: P043/P045: expose truncated or next for CLI JSON and app activity, or document the cap as a hard window. Do not reuse agent cursors on canon receipts.

findings.evidence: Executed goldens: missing canon_receipts table returns []; only_contested without claims returns [] while writes exist; unknown agent name, known empty access page, and limit=0 share {rows:[], next_cursor:null}. CLI JSON filter miss equals empty vault (ok + receipts=[]). Vault-unavailable remains distinct (withVault throw, exit 1; app no_vault).
findings.invariant: Unrecorded, unavailable, denied, and empty are distinct (root AGENTS.md).
findings.current: Several unrecorded/unavailable cases present as empty success lists. TUI already distinguishes no-writes copy from filter-miss copy.
findings.smallest_correction: Keep CLI empty-vault success. Do not turn unknown agent or missing schema into ok-empty without a distinct code. Do not merge agent identity misses into user kizuki audit.

findings.evidence: Golden canon-limit-zero-coerced.json: limit 0 yields one newest row. Golden agent-limit-zero.json: limit 0 yields empty page and shares the unknown-name branch.
findings.invariant: A requested empty page is empty, not a one-row page, and is not an unknown principal.
findings.current: Canon clamps to 1; agent empty-page shares unknown-name control flow.
findings.smallest_correction: Treat limit 0 as empty page on both list seams; keep unknown agent off that branch.

findings.evidence: agent add|revoke only. docs/wave1/plan/ARCHITECTURE.md still mentions kizuki agent audit <name>. Binding cli.md documents add/revoke only.
findings.current: User audit commands are canon-only. Agent listing is a core API, not a CLI verb.
findings.smallest_correction: P043/P045 must not invent kizuki agent audit unless a later packet owns that verb. P006 owns canonical docs if the wave1 line is restated.

hypotheses.note: Canon OFFSET pages can skip or repeat if a newer write arrives between pages. Not race-probed. Agent listing already uses a keyset cursor.
